_note: Sanitized reference, real workflow. Real campaign ID and any credential display names replaced with placeholders. Node logic and control flow are unchanged.

trigger.name: Qualified Deal From CRM
trigger.note: Fires on a CRM deal-stage-changed event (deal reached a qualifying stage).

stages.name: Set IDs
stages.note: Extracts deal_name, deal_id, deal_stage from the webhook body; sets the target outbound campaign ID as a fixed value (placeholder here - a real deployment maps this per deal-stage or pipeline).

stages.name: If Contacts Exist? -> Store Deals w/o Contacts
stages.note: A deal with no associated contact yet isn't dropped - it's logged to a side table, since the contact is often attached moments later by a separate process, not lost data.

stages.name: Set Contact ID -> Wait -> Get Contact Details
stages.note: Pulls full contact properties (email, name, phone, location) once a contact ID is known.

stages.name: If Email Exists? -> Insert Row (contacts without email)
stages.note: Same non-drop principle - a contact with no usable email is logged to its own side table rather than silently skipped.

stages.name: Create Lead in Outbound Platform
stages.note: Creates the lead in the target campaign with the CRM contact ID carried through as a custom field, so the reply-handling companion workflow can match a reply back to the right CRM contact.

stages.name: Set 'Synced' Flag in CRM
stages.note: PATCHes the CRM contact to mark it synced - the idempotency check: a contact already marked synced is a no-op on the next pass, not a duplicate outbound lead.

why_this_exists: This is the CRM -> outbound direction of the bidirectional sync. It's a separate, smaller, deal-triggered workflow rather than folded into the visitor-intent workflow (file 1) because the trigger, cadence, and failure modes are genuinely different: this one fires on a CRM event and deals with 'no contact yet' as a real, common, non-error state; the visitor-intent workflow fires on a webhook from a de-anonymization platform and has an entirely different disqualify/score/route decision to make before anything reaches the outbound platform at all.
